items.title: 13.10.1 Thande aabi sodium hydroxide ke saath reaction (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.10.1, printed page 300.

blocks.text: Chlorine thande aabi sodium hydroxide ke saath disproportionate ho kar sodium chloride aur sodium chlorate(I), NaClO (pehle sodium hypochlorite kehlata tha), banati hai: Cl2(g) + 2NaOH(aq) se NaCl(aq) + NaClO(aq) + H2O(l). Chlorine ki oxidation states Cl2 mein 0, NaCl mein -1 aur NaClO mein +1 hain: chlorine NaClO mein 0 se +1 tak oxidise aur NaCl mein 0 se -1 tak reduce hoti hai, ek saath oxidation aur reduction jo ise disproportionation banati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke NaCl mein chlorine '0 se 1' tak reduce hoti hai. Minus ka nishan chhoot gaya hai: NaCl mein chlorine -1 hai, is liye sahi '0 se -1' hai. Reduction mein oxidation number ghat-ta hai, barhta nahi.

blocks.prompt: Dikhayein ke Cl2 ka thande aabi KOH ke saath reaction disproportionation hai (Quick Check 13.5b).
blocks.explanation: Cl2 + 2KOH se KCl + KClO + H2O. Chlorine 0 se shuru hoti hai; KCl mein -1 hai (electron liya, reduced) aur KClO mein +1 (electron khoya, oxidised). Wahi element ek reaction mein oxidise aur reduce dono hota hai, to woh disproportionate hoti hai.

items: Thanda NaOH: Cl2 + 2NaOH se NaCl + NaClO + H2O; Cl 0 se -1 (reduced) aur 0 se +1 (oxidised); NaClO = sodium chlorate(I) (hypochlorite).
